items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: No, I gave him a horn. So, he appreciated it and we went to (heard) Herbie going like mad... he had 3 trombonists, something like that. So I go up to his sisters sometimes and we'd sit down and practice.

ctx.x: You said one of the things you want to do is get some new glasses and get your teeth fixed.
Yeah. I don't have no trouble playing without teeth now. I have a small bridge here but I don't want it like that. I want it right.
Do you have a dentist that you're planning to go to?
